title: A window that shows the work
task: Plot a function in a stated viewing window so that every zero, intersection and extreme value inside it can be read.

steps.text: Open Graph Settings and enter the lower and upper bounds for each axis.
Zoom to Fit brings the whole curve into view when part of it is off the screen.
A restriction in curly brackets at the end of the expression shows only the stated interval.
Select the curve and read each gray point of interest inside the window.

lines.shows: the graph of f on the interval only

lines.typed: Ctrl+Alt+G, then x from 0 to 2 and y from -1 to 1
lines.shows: the whole interval in the window, with one gray maximum

exam_habit.text: The window covers the whole stated interval, because when only the outer two crossings are used an interior crossing is integrated across.

bluebook_note: The default viewport depends on the size of the screen, so the window Bluebook opens with can differ from the one on another device.

sources.anchor_quote: You can also adjust the domain and range of the viewport manually.
